why: lint:name-inference reported 272 rules clean for its whole existence while never opening 207 rule files — it added only `src/rules/<rule>/index.ts`, so every rule laid out as a flat file was invisible. That is why hooks-exhaustive-deps shipped `/^set[A-Z]/`, `/dispatch/i` and `/Ref$/` deciding which React values were stable. The gate did not miss the pattern; it never read the file.
